name: context-menu-05
description: A sidebar folder tree where every row has its own context menu with folder actions.

files.content:
import { FilePlus as FilePlusIcon, Folder as FolderIcon, FolderPlus as FolderPlusIcon, Pencil as PencilIcon, Trash as TrashIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const folders = [ { name: "Clients", depth: 0 }, { name: "Brand identity", depth: 1 }, { name: "Next.js website", depth: 1 }, { name: "Designali", depth: 0 }, { name: "Templates", depth: 1 }, ] export default function FolderTreeRowMenu() { return (
{folders.map((folder) => ( {folder.name} {folder.name} New subfolder New file Rename Delete folder ))}
) }
